title: Building Community: Raku Firing

evidence_sentence: The firing workshop involves firing pieces multiple times in the raku kiln while working with an instructor.
evidence_quote: During the firing workshop, you'll work side-by-side with the instructor to fire the raku kiln multiple times.
summary: Fire bisque-fired pieces in the raku kiln over four hours, pulling work at temperature and placing into a reduction chamber for smoke effects. Cost $95; no prior experience needed.
